name: Customer DXF Analysis
description: DXF analysis toolkit: interactive quoting viewer (layer-colored flat pattern, per-line measurements, layer reassignment incl. WELD, total linear inches, DXF export) plus automated customer-guideline offsets - enter the plate thickness and every hole/cutout is increased per the customer's band table (2x-thickness cap, below-minimum warnings), then review each file and Save over the original or Export a copy. Batch mode queues a whole folder for one-by-one review. Manual amounts remain available via Adjust Dimensions.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Have the customer DXF file (or a folder of them) ready - you pick it when the app opens.
For automated offsets, know each part's plate thickness; you enter them up front (one "apply to all" box fills every file at once when they share a thickness).
how_it_works: Choose a single file or a whole folder, and whether to apply automated offsets.
The viewer shows the geometry layer-colored with per-line lengths and a total linear-inch count; you can reassign layers and adjust dimensions.

With automated offsets on, it applies the customer's thickness-based hole and cutout offsets to a temp copy for review - holes and slots drawn as polylines (old-style R12 exports included) are detected the same as circles and lines.
Adjust Dimensions has a plate-thickness box that fills in the guideline amount for you; you can still type any manual value over it.
output: A reviewed DXF - Save overwrites the original, Export writes an offset copy - plus the linear-inch totals for quoting.

fields.label: Default DXF File
fields.description: Optional DXF to open automatically in the viewer. Leave blank to pick a file each time.

fields.label: Manual hole diameter increase (inches)
fields.description: Default for the MANUAL Adjust Dimensions dialog (automated offsets use the customer guideline table instead). Default 0.0625 (1/16").

fields.label: Manual plate edge offset per side (inches)
fields.description: Default for the MANUAL Adjust Dimensions dialog (automated offsets never touch the outer profile). Default 0.0625 (1/16").

fields.label: Layer name for holes
fields.description: Hole geometry is moved to this layer in the OFFSET output DXF.

fields.label: Skip the Save overwrite warning
fields.description: When on, Save overwrites the original DXF without asking first. Set automatically by the warning's 'Don't ask me this again' checkbox; turn back off here to get the warning again.

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
